correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly handles repeated eigenvalues, g=0 and all positive strengths. Exact tensor propagator factorization and Cesàro Fourier selection isolate the two orthogonal layer blocks. Independent orthogonality of P_+ and P_- proves exact rank additivity. The Schur product theorem and projector orthogonality establish positive semidefiniteness and common zero-row-sum for every positive spectral-gap term. The K_m projectors give eigenvalues and ranks in all three coupling regimes. Actual embedded verify.py was run using exact rational spectral projectors for 42 profiles/2520 entries; finite checks corroborate rather than replace the unrestricted proof.

originality.rationale: The 2017 spectral/commutant work develops general average-mixing rank theory, while the 2023 product paper gives instantaneous Cartesian factorization (Eq. 7) and averaged trace comparisons (Theorem 17), plus a general single-graph Fourier expansion (Proposition 5). Those results strongly motivate and can be combined to derive parts of the present claim, but the inspected text does not give the matrix-valued positive half-gap selector, its additive rank law for arbitrary uniform couplings, or the three-regime complete-graph bilayer rank classification. No logically independent foundational method is claimed. Semantic literature searches and comparison with fixed unweighted special cases found no explicit dominating statement. Residual risk: another general rank theorem may subsume the formula.
residual_risks: Because the main matrix identity specializes known Fourier and instantaneous Cartesian-product formulas, an explicit identical-layer version may be documented in a paper not located by the searches. Novelty does not extend to the standard product factorization or spectral Cesàro formula.
Published fixed unweighted product special cases exist; only the all-real-symmetric, tunable-coupling rank law and resonance structure are assessed as new.
No independent external priority determination or mathematical validation has been performed.

value.rationale: The object is a natural two-layer quantum transport Hamiltonian with experimentally meaningful tunable rung coupling. Its long-time probability-profile rank is classified for arbitrary real-symmetric intralayer dynamics by finitely many explicit spectral gap matrices; the baseline and exceptional coupling strengths are complete and exactly computable. The g=m/2 resonance in coupled K_m restores m-1 independent directions and shows a nontrivial structural effect, not merely a change of notation or a small numerical improvement. Limitations include no near-resonance finite-time estimates and no nonuniform rungs.
